_doc: Policy for scripts/hooks/version-bump-guard.js. The guard refuses (warn or block) git commits that stage framework-prefix files while framework/releases/<version.json#version>/ already has a minted capsule. Forces a version bump before more framework changes can ship — closes the 2026-05-20 capsule-staleness gap (28 assets + 179 SHA drifts accumulated against 0.8.0 over 5 days without a bump).

enforcement._note: Default is warn during soft rollout. Flip to 'block' after 2026-06-15 or once the team is comfortable with the friction. Soft-rollout downgrades 'block' to 'warn' until the date passes; after the date, the declared mode is the effective mode.

bypass._note: Both bypass mechanisms log to stderr so misuse is observable.
